_comment: lane L8b-1 (plr-d10) - the ONE crop <-> schedule rule, pinned on both sides. `cycleCrop` is a crop name as a farm stores it (a crop season's crop_name; the phone's CropProfile.name). `cropCode` is the crop the rule reads it as: the name read through the founder's crop master (any of its English or Marathi names, canonical or alternate), then the phone's canonical crop code. A schedule matches a season when both read as the same code. The phone's TemplateCatalog vitest (getTemplatesForCrop / scheduleCropCode) and the server's ScheduleLibrary (domain test + real-Postgres adopt test) read THIS file; change either side and one goes red.
